sources.title: google/tipsv1-g14: Zero-Shot Image Classification Model | ExploreAI.tools
sources.snippet: google/tipsv1-g14 is an open-source AI model hosted on Hugging Face, designed for zero-shot image classification. It supports feature extraction and is built on the TIPSv2 architecture, with an Apache-2.0 license.

sources.snippet: google/tipsv1-g14-lowres is an official Hugging Face model by Google, designed for zero-shot image classification. It supports feature extraction and uses contrastive learning, with tags indicating TIPsv2 and an associated arXiv paper.
